conflict_zone_intervals — DRIVE crossing op

• Data kinds: any → table

• Call: import fullseye as fs; fs.ledger.conflict_zone_intervals(dist_to_zone, zone_length: 'float', car_length: 'float', *, v0: 'float', accel: 'float' = 0.0, v_max: 'Optional[float]' = None) -> 'Dict[str, object]' (to call the implementation directly, import drivecrossing; drivecrossing.conflict_zone_intervals(dist_to_zone, zone_length: 'float', car_length: 'float', *, v0: 'float', accel: 'float' = 0.0, v_max: 'Optional[float]' = None) -> 'Dict[str, object]'; from the registry, opsdrive.get("conflict_zone_intervals"))

Usage

> This operator's description has not been translated yet. The original text follows as it is.

衝突の領域(交差点の中で 2 つの進路が重なる所)を車が占める時刻 [t_in, t_out] (閉形式、配列可)。

前端が dist_to_zone 進むと入り、前端が dist_to_zone + zone_length + car_length 進むと後端が出る。初速 v0 から

`accel で v_max` まで加速(accel = 0 なら一定の速さ)。既に領域に入っている(dist_to_zone < 0)場合は t_in = 0。
